content.bridge_context: Understanding how animals obtain energy and sustain life.

units.title: Nutrition in Animals
units.explanation: Animals are heterotrophs. They ingest food, digest it, and absorb nutrients.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name an animal that eats only plants. / केवल पौधे खाने वाले एक जानवर का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Respiration
units.explanation: The process of breaking down food in cells to release energy. Aerobic (with oxygen) and Anaerobic (without).
units.dual_language_instruction: Which gas do we breathe in? / हम कौन सी गैस अंदर लेते हैं?
